inference.body:
data, rate = sf.read(input_audio)
is_stereo = len(data.shape) > 1 and data.shape[1] > 1
if is_stereo:
    data = data.T

reduced = nr.reduce_noise(
    y=data,
    sr=rate,
    stationary=stationary,
    use_torch=use_torch,
    prop_decrease=prop_decrease
)

if is_stereo:
    reduced = reduced.T

out_file = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False)
out_file.close()
sf.write(out_file.name, reduced, rate)
return out_file.name

import tempfile
import soundfile as sf
import noisereduce as nr

inputs.info: If checked, keeps the estimated noise threshold at the same level across the whole signal. If unchecked, continuously updates the threshold over time (non-stationary).

inputs.name: stationary

inputs.label: Use PyTorch
inputs.name: use_torch

inputs.info: The proportion of noise to reduce (1.0 = 100% reduction).
inputs.label: Noise Reduction Proportion
inputs.name: prop_decrease
